cluster_name.description: Name of the EKS cluster where the resource is located.

kind.description: Kind of the involved object (e.g., "Pod", "Deployment", "Service"). Must match the resource kind exactly.

tools.name: get_pod_logs
tools.description:
Get logs from a pod in a Kubernetes cluster.
This tool retrieves logs from a specified pod in an EKS cluster,

cluster_name.description: Name of the EKS cluster where the pod is running.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the pod is located.

pod_name.description: Name of the pod to retrieve logs from.

container_name.description: Name of the specific container to get logs from. Required only if the pod contains multiple containers.

since_seconds.description: Only return logs newer than this many seconds. Useful for getting recent logs without retrieving the entire history.

tail_lines.description: Number of lines to return from the end of the logs. Default: 100. Use higher values for more context.

limit_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to return. Default: 10KB (10240 bytes). Prevents retrieving extremely large log files.

previous.description: Return previous terminated container logs (defaults to false). Useful to get logs for pods that are restarting.

tools.name: list_k8s_resources
tools.description:
List Kubernetes resources of a specific kind.
This tool lists Kubernetes resources of a specified kind in an E

cluster_name.description: Name of the EKS cluster where the resources are located.

kind.description: Kind of the Kubernetes resources to list (e.g., 'Pod', 'Service', 'Deployment'). Use the list_api_versions tool to find available resource kinds.

api_version.description: API version of the Kubernetes resources (e.g., 'v1', 'apps/v1', 'networking.k8s.io/v1'). Use the list_api_versions tool to find available API versions.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Kubernetes resources to list. If not provided, resources will be listed across all namespaces (for namespaced resources).

label_selector.description: Label selector to filter resources (e.g., 'app=nginx,tier=frontend'). Uses the same syntax as kubectl's --selector flag.

field_selector.description: Field selector to filter resources (e.g., 'metadata.name=my-pod,status.phase=Running'). Uses the same syntax as kubectl's --field-selector flag.
